description: This file defines a class for a chat prompt template component, including its properties, constructor, and initialization method. It imports various utilities and external prompt classes, and exports the class as a module.

classes.name: ChatPromptTemplate_Prompts
classes.description: A class implementing INode that creates and initializes a chat prompt template with optional message history and prompt values.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the properties of the ChatPromptTemplate_Prompts class, setting labels, inputs, and other metadata.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the chat prompt template, optionally including message history from executable code, and returns the prompt object.
